name: Trailmarks
summary:
Trailmarks is a globe-trotting trivia adventure where what you know pays for where you go. Answer questions to earn your fare, then pick the next flight, train, bus or boat out of whatever city you're standing in - and try to keep going. Your score is simply how far you got.

On iOS, Trailmarks is a card-based trivia roguelike inspired by Reigns, where players makes decision on one card at the time, deciding between answering a question, traveling to a new destination or drawing random cards. All while their mood must be constantly balanced to prevent burnout. It's a calm and casual trivia game structured as a global adventure.
